# The source repositories

This page is for developers who want to change a package, build it again or base their own package on one. The
package server holds only the finished `.ezpkg` archives; their unpacked source, one folder per package, lives in
separate GitHub repositories of `se7enxweb`. This page lists them, shows their layout and maps every package of the
6.0.15 index to its repository. Every repository was checked with `gh api` (read only) on 2026-10-18.

## The repositories

|---|---|---|

The old package folders of the 3.x to 5.x releases, no longer on the server, are kept in
[se7enxweb/deprecated.ezpublish.packages.ezpublish.one](https://github.com/se7enxweb/deprecated.ezpublish.packages.ezpublish.one).

> **Note**
> `plain_site` is on the package server but is not in any of these repositories. To change it, start from the
> `.ezpkg` itself ([Downloading a package by hand](downloading-a-package-by-hand.md)).

## The common layout

`sevenx-ezpackage` and `cjw_multisite-ezpackage` have this layout, and so do ezwebin, ezflow, ezstarrating,
ezgmaplocation and ezwt (`ezflow-ezpackage` also has `doc/`). `ezdemo-ezpackage`, `ezpaypal-ezpackage` and
`ezcomments-ezpackage` have only `packages/` (plus web files in `ezdemo-ezpackage` and a `README.md` in
`ezpaypal-ezpackage`). `build.sh` is in seven of them: sevenx, cjw_multisite (since 2026-10-19), ezwebin, ezflow, ezdemo,
ezpaypal and ezstarrating.

```text
packages/
  build.sh                    packs every folder into <folder>.ezpkg
  <name>/                     one package, unpacked
    package.xml               the definition
    documents/LICENCE         the license text
    files/default/...         thumbnail and other files
    settings/...              install scripts of a site package
    ezcontentclass/...        classes of a contentclass package
    ezextension/...           the extension of an extension package
bin/
  pack.sh                     packs every folder, into --output-dir
  repack_extension.sh         rebuilds an extension package from an installation
  ezpxmlextfilelist.php       lists the files of an extension directory (-e <extension>)
ant/
  createzpkg.sh               packs one folder
  ezwebin.properties
```

What goes into each kind of package folder is described in
[What a site installer package is](../basics/what-a-site-installer-package-is.md) and
[The .ezpkg file](../basics/the-ezpkg-file.md).

## The scripts

| Script | What it does | Leaves out |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/build.sh` | run inside `packages/`: for each folder, `tar -zcf ../<folder>.ezpkg` of its content, so the `.ezpkg` files land next to the folders | `.git`, `.gitignore`, `.gitattributes`, `.gitmodules`, `.svn`, `.hg`, `.DS_Store`, `.idea`, `.vscode`, `node_modules`, `*~`, `*.swp`; in the 7x and CJW repositories also `*.bak` and `*.bak.*` (since 2026-10-19) |
| `bin/pack.sh` | run from the repository root: packs each folder of `packages/` except `package_set` into `--output-dir=<dir>` (default `/tmp/ezwebin/packages`) | the same list, plus `.cache` and `pack_and_publish.bat` |
| `ant/createzpkg.sh` | `createzpkg.sh <source> <destination>`: packs one folder into `<destination>.ezpkg` | `.svn`, `.cache`, `pack_and_publish.bat` |
| `bin/repack_extension.sh` | `--with-ezp=<dir>`: recreates the extension package from an installation; the result lands in `var/storage/packages/local/` | |

The archive's top level is the package folder's content, so `package.xml` is at the top of the `.ezpkg`, as the
importer expects. `build.sh` came to `sevenx-ezpackage` on 2026-10-14 ("The package build script, which leaves version
control folders and editor files out of every package"). How to use it: [Rebuilding with build.sh](../your-own/rebuilding-with-build-sh.md).

> **Warning**
> Give `bin/pack.sh` an `--output-dir` of your own. Its default lies in the system's shared temporary folder.

## Which package comes from where

| Packages of the 6.0.15 index | Repository |
|---|---|
| `sevenx_*` (14) | sevenx-ezpackage |
| `cjw_multisite`, `cjw_multisite_democontent` | cjw_multisite-ezpackage |
| `ezwebin_*` (10) | ezwebin-ezpackage |
| `ezflow_*` (7) | ezflow-ezpackage |
| `ezdemo_*` (6) | ezdemo-ezpackage |
| `ezpaypal_extension`, `ezstarrating_extension`, `ezgmaplocation_extension`, `ezwt_extension` | their own `-ezpackage` repository each |
| `plain_site` | none of these |

That is 43 of the 44 packages of the 6.0.15 index.

## Reading a repository

```bash
# the folders and their history, without a full checkout of large binaries
git clone --filter=blob:none https://github.com/se7enxweb/sevenx-ezpackage.git
cd sevenx-ezpackage
ls packages/
git log --oneline -- packages/sevenx_multisite
```

Commit messages in these repositories start with `Added:`, `Updated:`, `Removed:` or `Renamed:` and name the package,
for example "Updated: The installer of the sevenx_site package activates ezownerchange, so changing the owner of
content is available in a new installation". The same change then appears as a separate commit on the package server
([How a release reaches the package server](how-a-release-reaches-the-package-server.md)).

To change a package for yourself, fork its repository ([Forking a site package](../your-own/forking-a-site-package.md));
to change it for everyone, open a pull request there, and for a new package see
[Contribute your site package](../contribute-your-site-package.md).
